angles: Agyn fills the gap between agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) and production infrastructure — it's not another framework but a runtime layer
The Terraform-based agent-as-code approach brings GitOps workflows to AI agent management
Credential isolation via MCP container separation is a unique security differentiator — the model never sees credentials in its context
Serverless agent model (per-invocation containers) contrasts with always-on agent patterns, offering better cost efficiency for bursty workloads
OpenZiti zero-trust networking eliminates the need for VPNs when agents access internal services
Agyn's agent-agnostic design means teams can swap between Claude Code, Codex, or custom agents without changing infrastructure
The 'more agents than employees' thesis — every company will soon run far more AI agents than people
